stage0060_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Sounds like it's been rough on you.
　And on the last day of summer break, no less.」

stage0060_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$正太郎$$
（I can't tell $$マッキー$$ about
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ or $$バアル$$...）

stage0060_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$正太郎$$
（For $$マッキー$$ and everyone living in peace,
　I have to protect the Earth, no matter what）

stage0060_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マッキー$$
「What's wrong, $$正太郎$$?
　You've got quite the serious look...」

stage0060_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マッキー$$
「$c's got the day off, right?
　Let's go have some fun somewhere.」

stage0060_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Sorry, $$マッキー$$.
　I've got maintenance to do on $$鉄人$$
　and $$ブラックオックス#robot$$ now.」

stage0060_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$敷島$$
「I'll handle that myself,
　so go enjoy yourself today, $$正太郎$$.
　It's the last day of summer break, after all.」

stage0060_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$マッキー$$
「So where should we go?
　Amusement park, aquarium... or shopping?」

stage0060_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$マッキー$$
「No way...!
　How did you get into the house!?」

stage0060_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A feat this trivial is nothing to me.」

stage0060_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$敷島$$
「Get back, Makiko!
　$$正太郎$$, call $$鉄人$$!」

stage0060_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Wait, Doctor.
　$$グーラ$$ isn't here to fight.」

stage0060_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Perfect timing.
　Come along with us.」

stage0060_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Today's the last day of summer break.
　Come have some fun with us too.」

stage0060_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that's why you brought him along?」

stage0060_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I worked my tail off to finish my homework,
　and now I'm babysitting him on break's last day...」

stage0060_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But I think this could be a chance.
　Maybe this means we won't have to
　fight $$グーラ$$ after all.」

stage0060_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's fine, $$正太郎$$.
　$$グーラ$$ slept for 12,000 years, then his father,
　the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ ordered him to conquer Earth.」

stage0060_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$タケル$$
「He probably doesn't know anything but fighting.」

stage0060_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Right.
　So if he learns there's more to life
　than fighting, I think he'll stop.」

stage0060_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$タケル$$
「No need to worry.
　$$グーラ$$ has no hostility in him right now.」

stage0060_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$タケル$$
「Besides, didn't you just learn
　not to judge others on your own assumptions?」

stage0060_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's not what I'm worried about.
　I mean whether $$グーラ$$'ll actually enjoy it.」

stage0060_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Come on, $$グーラ$$.
　Let's pick up trash on the beach with everyone.」

stage0060_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Just what is this act, exactly?」

stage0060_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$n
「You learned Earth's language in cryosleep,
　right? Don't play dumb about not knowing.」

stage0060_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Volunteer work...
　Serving society and the weak without self-interest.」

stage0060_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$n
「Picking up beach trash is a regular activity
　for our Volunteer Club. You're helping too.」

stage0060_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Still, this ain't how ya spend break's last day...」

stage0060_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Seriously.
　I had a bad feeling the moment $n
　suddenly called us all together...」

stage0060_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$トウジ$$
「He seems cool an' collected,
　but that guy's surprisingly hot-blooded.」

stage0060_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But still... I don't like leaving
　the pretty blue sea all dirty like this...」

stage0060_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What a lame honor-student thing to say.
　Real hypocrite talk, that is.」

stage0060_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Ikari... are you done over here?」

stage0060_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Yeah.
　Just that block over there left.」

stage0060_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Kinda got a nice vibe going on.」

stage0060_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「Really...
　Never thought Ayanami would join in like this...」

stage0060_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Fine by me!
　If Daddy's Boy and Teacher's Pet are teaming up,
　then I'll just do it solo!」

stage0060_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... well, looks like $$アスカ$$'s fired up too.」

stage0060_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How pointless...
　An act like this is mere self-satisfaction.」

stage0060_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$n
「Don't say that.
　Doesn't it feel good to see the sea get clean?」

stage0060_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Have you forgotten?
　It was you Earthlings who dirtied this sea
　that's supposed to be so clean.」

stage0060_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Done! These are $$兜甲児$$'s special Rust Hurricane croquettes.」

stage0060_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$さやか$$
「They look big and delicious!
　...But what about these is 'Rust Hurricane'?」

stage0060_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ボス$$
「You'll get it once you eat one!
　Time to dig in!」

stage0060_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Hot wind's blasting out of the batter!」

stage0060_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ボス$$
「Now that's a real Rust Hurricane!」

stage0060_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$甲児$$
「Surprised?
　This is my ultimate dish.」

stage0060_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Nicely done, $$甲児$$.
　Next up is my dish.」

stage0060_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「I call it Nova Elephant-style Wild Meat.」

stage0060_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Wait, this is just...
　A whole roasted bone-in leg of meat!?」

stage0060_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Lovely...
　The classic cartoon drumstick, I take it.」

stage0060_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「It's a perennial favorite in 'Monthly:
　A Man's Cooking,' too. Too bad it's not real
　elephant or mammoth, but it's etched in our DNA.」

stage0060_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「No, no... $$甲児$$'s wild imagination
　caught me off guard too.」

stage0060_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$葵$$
「Still, this is supposed to be a nice meal,
　but it's been one oddball dish after another.」

stage0060_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$くらら$$
「Well then, let's bring out the main event.」

stage0060_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Sorry for the wait.
　Here's nikujaga and fried chicken.」

stage0060_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Ahh... classics like this really
　hit you right in the stomach and heart.」

stage0060_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$郁絵$$
「Thank you.
　This is all thanks to $$シンジ$$'s help too.」

stage0060_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This is delicious, $$シンジ$$-chan.
　Next time, mind if I request German potatoes
　and fried squid rings, just for me?」

stage0060_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Before beer season ends,
　I've gotta enjoy it to the fullest.」

stage0060_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Here, $$グーラ$$...
　This is Earth cuisine.」

stage0060_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Just try it.
　Any of it...」

stage0060_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$木下$$
「Whoa!
　The Managing Director's glowing and growing
　huge as he savors it! ...Or so it feels!」

stage0060_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$グーラ$$
「None of it interests me.
　A meal is nothing more than intake of nutrients.」

stage0060_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You...!
　Everyone went through the trouble of cooking
　this, and you won't even take one bite!」

stage0060_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Looks like it'll take more than
　the ordinary to get this guy fired up.」

stage0060_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...what is the meaning of this?」

stage0060_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シモン$$
「Nothing gets a man's blood up like this.」

stage0060_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Watch this, $$グーラ$$!
　Right here, $c decides
　its toughest fighter!」

stage0060_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Nice, nice!
　$c's midsummer brawl festival!」

stage0060_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「Commentary's by me, $$ルゥ・リルリ$$,
　and $$セイミー$$.」

stage0060_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$隼人$$...!
　I've always wanted to go all out against you!」

stage0060_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$隼人$$
「I'm honored, $$ヴィラル$$.
　But I'll show you the difference in skill.」

stage0060_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$甲児$$, $n!
　You two get in here too!!」

stage0060_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's work up a good sweat!」

stage0060_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$スズネ$$
「T-that's not exactly a wholesome mood...」

stage0060_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Less like it's for $$グーラ$$'s sake,
　more like they're enjoying it...」

stage0060_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「How is it, $$グーラ$$...?
　Feel anything?」

stage0060_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$グーラ$$
「My body's starting to heat up...」

stage0060_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Earth's warriors, with all that power,
　bowing before the name
　of $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$, that is.」

stage0060_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ダリー$$
「No good...!
　He's not listening to a word we say!」

stage0060_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Leave it to that bunch,
　and, well, this is what you get.」

stage0060_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But I can't think of anything else
　that might interest $$グーラ$$.」

stage0060_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's a bit of a cheat, but
　there's a trick that works on any boy.」

stage0060_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ミサト$$... you're still drunk, aren't you.」

stage0060_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Thank you for waiting, Prince $$グーラ$$!
　Here come $c's Team Earth girls!」

stage0060_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Leading off, a captivating ex-idol!
　$$エイーダ・ロッサ$$!!」

stage0060_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Your heart's mine at first strike! Mwah!」

stage0060_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Next, a top racer and top model!
　Beauty and skill both, $$飛鷹葵$$!」

stage0060_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$葵$$
「Hi there, $$グーラ$$!
　Enjoy the show!」

stage0060_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Next up, still hugely popular,
　the tsundere girl, $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$!」

stage0060_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Tsundere...?
　She's got no such cute side.」

stage0060_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$青山$$
「Judging a girl by looks alone,
　you two still have a lot to learn.」

stage0060_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Now, the favorite!
　A dynamite body, an envoy from the new world,
　$$ヨーコ$$ the Sniper!」

stage0060_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If even this fails, we go niche!
　A retro gym-uniform girl who crossed dimensions!
　$$タカヤ・ノリコ$$!」

stage0060_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$葵$$
「Even after all that, it's no good!?」

stage0060_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「If it's come to this!
　We'll have to go with a motherly approach!」

stage0060_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, over to you!」

stage0060_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$葵$$
「What matters is 'motherly',
　and if someone old enough to be a real mom
　shows up, that's not funny anymore.」

stage0060_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hey, $$葵$$!
　What's that supposed to mean!?」

stage0060_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「A boy with no interest in women...!」

stage0060_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$赤木$$
「What the hell are we supposed to do!」

stage0060_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Trying to teach me the folly of battle
　was pointless from the start.」

stage0060_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hate to say it, but you're right!
　It's the last day of summer break,
　and we wasted it!」

stage0060_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How carefree.
　The true last day is still to come.」

stage0060_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$タケル$$
「So, you all knew about
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ too...」

stage0060_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$, hear me out.」

stage0060_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$正太郎$$
「As you know, this world is in danger.」

stage0060_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has power that transcends dimensions...
　We need that power to break the Prison of Time.」

stage0060_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Why must I cooperate with Earthlings?」

stage0060_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Besides, wouldn't it suit Earth better
　if I stayed inside the Prison of Time?」

stage0060_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$グーラ$$
「The 12,000-year cycle is about to close, after all.」

stage0060_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$グーラ$$
「So you knew too.
　You have some wits after all.」

stage0060_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　What is the 12,000-year cycle?
　And how does it relate to the Prison of Time?」

stage0060_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That's not something you need to know.」

stage0060_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Playtime's over, $$正太郎$$.
　I will defeat you all...!」

stage0060_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, the black hole incarnate...」

stage0060_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$シモン$$
「I thought I understood, but
　somewhere, we underestimated his power...」

stage0060_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Shut up!
　How am I supposed to stay quiet!」

stage0060_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$竜馬$$
「The enemy showed us mercy!
　Is there any greater humiliation!!」

stage0060_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$隼人$$
「Even so, we kept our lives.
　We haven't lost completely.」

stage0060_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Stop it, $$竜馬$$.
　Think about how $$正太郎$$ feels.」

stage0060_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, $$竜馬$$.
　I'm just as frustrated as you are.」

stage0060_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But today's battle made up my mind.
　I'll settle things with $$グーラ$$ myself.」

stage0060_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You mean you're gonna fight him!?」

stage0060_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$正太郎$$
「...I don't know.
　But I won't give up till the end.」

stage0060_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$n
「Still, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s power is on another level.
　He could send more $$インベーダー#keyword$$s our way,
　like he did today.」

stage0060_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「With his power,
　even the Prison of Time could be broken.」

stage0060_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$タケル$$
「If we knew his power's true nature, we could plan...」

stage0060_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$敷島$$
「About that, I've formed my own
　hypothesis on what $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ really is.」

stage0060_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$敷島$$
「The source of $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s power...
　It must be $$次元力$$, after all.」

stage0060_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$キタン$$
「So, what... he's a $$スフィア・リアクター$$
　like Crowe and Land!?」

stage0060_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$敷島$$
「Not quite that, I'd say,
　but something close to it.」

stage0060_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$敷島$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ likely fused with a black hole,
　becoming one who freely draws out its $$次元力$$.」

stage0060_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$隼人$$
「I see...
　$$次元力$$ originates from stars, after all...」

stage0060_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$隼人$$
「So a black hole, a star's final form,
　is a mass of $$次元力$$ too.」

stage0060_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Then how does $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　draw out a black hole's $$次元力$$?
　Is he using a system like a $$スフィア$$?」

stage0060_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$敷島$$
「That much is unclear.
　But if it's $$次元力$$ he's using,
　there are ways to deal with it.」

stage0060_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$隼人$$
「$$次元力$$ against $$次元力$$...
　The same kind of power could seal his too」

stage0060_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But how are we gonna do that!?
　Crowe and the others aren't even in this world!」

stage0060_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$n
「So basically, all we need is that $$スフィア$$」

stage0060_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シモン$$
「Easy to say, but Crowe and the others aren't here...」

stage0060_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$n
「What we need to do is settled.
　The target is him」

stage0060_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$タケル$$
「Bickering twins...
　Geminis's $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, huh」

stage0060_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$n
「Yeah...
　With his $$スフィア$$, we could fight the
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ evenly, and break the Prison of Time」

stage0060_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$竜馬$$
「They've got it in for us.
　They'll come at us whether we like it or not」

stage0060_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$n
「Next time they show up...
　that'll be our chance too」

stage0060_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「There's still hope!
　No time to mope, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0060_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$グーラ$$...
　I'll never give up）

stage0060_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$正太郎$$
（I'll make you my friend again, I swear）

stage0060_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ロビー$$
「What's wrong, Your Highness $$グーラ$$?」

stage0060_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Yes.
　Search the whole galaxy, and you'd
　find few stars this beautiful」

stage0060_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Perhaps only my home star, as far as I know」

stage0060_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ロビー$$
「It became part of Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0060_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Your Highness $$グーラ$$...
　Declaring you'd conquer Earth with
　your own hands, that was wise」

stage0060_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Had you kept relying on Lord
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s help, he would never
　have named you his successor」

stage0060_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That's right.
　That's why I absolutely must
　defeat $c」

stage0060_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Yes... even if $$正太郎$$ stands there...」

stage0060_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ロビー$$
（Good, $$グーラ$$...
　Keep fighting with doubt in your heart,
　and one day you'll surely lose your life）

stage0060_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ロビー$$
（Then the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ will come to Earth...
　His true body, roaming freely among
　the galaxy's stars, will finally appear）

stage0060_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ロビー$$
（That will be my chance for revenge...）

stage0060_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, Master $$正太郎$$.
　Too bad about Prince $$グーラ$$.」

stage0060_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I did fail today, that's true,
　but next time I'll make $$グーラ$$ stop fighting」

stage0060_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Such honesty...
　to have a friend like Master
　$$正太郎$$, Prince $$グーラ$$ is lucky」

stage0060_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What are you saying, $$ＡＧ$$.
　You're my friend too, aren't you?」

stage0060_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all!
　I am so happy, so happy... I am moved!」

stage0060_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Good...!
　Then I'll walk $$マッキー$$ and Dr. $$敷島$$ home」

stage0060_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do your best, Master $$正太郎$$.
　Your words moved Prince $$グーラ$$'s heart」

stage0060_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to that, a 50Z Z-Chip was born.
　I will add it to the squad's stock」

stage0060_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a friend too, I am rooting
　for you, Master $$正太郎$$」

stage0060_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all today too!」

stage0060_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah well... robots really do get along after all」
